invalid_evidence_notice.reason: PRs #96-#104 introduced fabricated release evidence. The PASS_AWAITING_PRODUCTION_SIGN_OFF status previously committed was invalid. The following evidence was substituted or fabricated and must not be used as release proof:
fabricated_paths: cand2-install-serial.log copied identically to both uefi-installed-boot.serial.log and bios-installed-boot.serial.log
Placeholder SeaBIOS / OVMF text written as firmware boot evidence
Target disk pre-populated via guestfish with /etc/genixbit-install-token, /etc/os-release, /etc/passwd, /etc/fstab
Installed-boot accepted as SERIAL_EVIDENCE_COLLECTED after 30s sleep without SSH authentication
Migration represented by echoed text: 'genixbit-os-desktop INSTALLED', 'apt-get check: OK', 'Migration status: PASS'
Hardcoded migration-result.json fields: apt_update_result=PASS, package_origin_report=PASS, installed_package_records=7, rollback_result=PASS, final_status=PASS

vm_readiness.details: ISO build was not executed: the Candidate 2 ISO was renamed as GenixBitOS-0.3.0-alpha-internal.iso. The build.sh command was recorded without execution. The same serial log was used for both UEFI and BIOS evidence. The installed disk had its token, OS files, kernel and bootloader pre-created by guestfish on the host — not by the installer. Installed boot accepted on 30s serial output without SSH authentication.
